segments.text: India or Pakistan. Part two. Who has more mobile phones per hundred people?
India. By just two and a half phones.
Round two. Whose economy grows faster? India or Pakistan?
India. More than twice as fast.
Final round. Money from family abroad, per person. India or Pakistan?
India or Pakistan? Comment your flag.
